title: Founder retainer discount timing and invoice path
text:
Founder retainer discount timing and invoice path

['From: Elena Marsh <elena@nebulab.io>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Founders program — combining retainer discount with stipend?

Hey Mateo,

Quick question from our side as we prep for the cohort: we have a 6-month retainer budget for infra and would like to combine that with the founders stipend you mentioned on the call. Procurement is asking whether the retainer discount can be applied on top of the stipend (so the stipend is drawn first, then the retainer gets a further 15% off for the committed months).

Can Redwood make an exception for cohort startups to stack the two? If so we need the timeline for invoicing and a short note we can share with finance (they require a line-itemed invoice and a signed addendum).

Appreciate any quick guidance — demo next week is locked in.

Thanks,
Elena Marsh
Founder & CEO, Nebula Labs
elena@nebulab.io
[Attachment referenced: Program_Specs.pdf (pdf)]', "From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Marsh <elena@nebulab.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Founders program — combining retainer discount with stipend?

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and congrats on getting into the cohort. Short answer: we can make a limited, documented exception for stacking the stipend with a short-term retainer discount, but we need to put a 3-condition safety guard in the contract: 1) stipend applies first and is non-refundable, 2) retainer discount applies to billed usage after stipend depletion for up to N months (we typically do 3–6), 3) addendum signed before first invoice.

I'll loop in Lauren for the invoice path and Ben for partner-side approval on the discount stack. Attached is a simple worksheet that shows pricing paths depending on stipend drawdown and retainer length — it should help finance model it quickly.

Next steps I propose:
- Lauren to confirm invoice cadence and whether we can produce a single line-item invoice that shows stipend and discounted retainer separately.
- Ben to confirm a one-off 15% retainer discount for up to 4 months (or propose alternatives).
- Elena, if that works, sign the addendum (DocuSign) and we’ll issue the first invoice the week of Oct 18.

I attached a draft proposal for your team to circulate.

Cheers,
Mateo
Director, Growth — Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
[Attachment: Accelerator_Flex_Proposal.xlsx (xlsx)]", 'From: Elena Marsh <elena@nebulab.io>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Founders program — combining retainer discount with stipend?

Thanks Mateo — that approach sounds reasonable. A couple of procurement constraints from our side:
- Invoice needs a separate line for the stipend (grant) and the retainer with discount applied, plus PO number on the invoice.
- We prefer monthly invoices rather than upfront for the 4-month retainer.
- Legal wants the addendum to explicitly state the stacking order and the effective months.

If you can produce the addendum and the sample invoice layout, I’ll run it through our finance team today and share a PO by tomorrow if all looks good.

Best,
Elena

On Oct 11, 2026, at 11:12 AM, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Elena — thanks for the clear ask and congrats on getting into the cohort. Short answer: we can make a limited, documented exception for stacking the stipend with a short-term retainer discount...', 'From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Elena Marsh <elena@nebulab.io>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T10:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Founders program — combining retainer discount with stipend?

Hi Elena (and team),

We can do the invoicing exactly as requested. For clarity:
- We will generate monthly invoices. Each invoice will show:
  * Line 1: Founders Stipend (one-time grant) — applied until exhausted.
  * Line 2: Retainer (usage/invoiceable services) — with applied 15% discount for the agreed months.
- PO number field: please send your PO and billing contact.
- DocuSign: I uploaded a short addendum that states the stacking, discount percentage, and effective dates. Please review and sign; link below.

I attached a sample invoice (NL-Invoice-202610.pdf) for formatting. Once signed we’ll issue the first invoice week of Oct 18 and set month-to-month billing thereafter; if Nebula prefers, we can set it to net-30.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/12345-accelerator-addendum

Attachment: NL-Invoice-202610.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Finance Manager — Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com', 'From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T16:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Founders program — combining retainer discount with stipend?

Looping back — approved on the partnership side for a one-time exception: 15% retainer discount for up to 4 months, stackable with the stipend as described. Condition: discount applies only to invoiceable usage after stipend lines have been consumed. No other promotions can be stacked.

Mateo — please confirm the final addendum text and we’ll route for signature (I reviewed and left a single comment in the doc). Once signed, finance will set up the monthly invoices and add PO info.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if Elena’s team needs a quick walkthrough of the invoice layout.

Best,
Ben Carter
Partnerships — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
[Attachment: Retainer_Discount_Addendum.docx (docx)]']
